experiment: CKA weight shrinkage toward the sqrt prior
finding: Monotone decrease as the learned CKA weight enters. The hand-chosen sqrt(edges) rule is the best of everything tried: kernel ensemble with alpha-0.35 recalibration, uniform / sqrt / CKA / CKA x sqrt / shrunk combinations, top-k selection, geometric averaging. Final honest number: 0.6320 +/- 0.0089 over 25 seeds vs published 0.627.
